findings.desc: The init-rerun merge fix (cli-init.ts cb19e86e8) has no automated regression test. The fix corrects a bug where only hooks[0] was inspected, silently dropping every hook entry after the first on init-rerun. The existing smoke test (english-only-guards-smoke.ts) covers the fresh-init path only. No test exercises: run lattice init on a settings.json that already contains the scope PreToolUse guard -> verify (a) english-only guard is added without duplicating the scope guard, and (b) both entries are present in the merged result. This rerun-merge path is the specific scenario the fix addresses and it currently has only manual before/after attestation in the commit message. A permanent regression test is warranted to prevent silent regression.
findings.resolvedReason: Added Test 7 to english-only-guards-smoke.ts (commit ea8b568c9): seeds a temp project with a scope-only PreToolUse settings.json, runs lattice init, and asserts BOTH the scope-pretool and english-only-guard hooks are present (scope not duplicated). This is durable regression coverage for the init-rerun merge path that the escalation review exposed; all 7 smoke tests green.
